findings.title: Detection opens into an answer
findings.claim: The human question in 99:3 and the earth's informed report in 99:4 make the focus showing read as the perceptual answer to an event first noticed and asked about.
findings.mechanism: The human-detection carrier in 99:3 is followed by the report carrier in 99:4; their contact returns through the focus's passive showing, so what people receive in 99:6 closes an inquiry opened by bewilderment.
findings.reader_payoff: The focus departure becomes part of a sequence of understanding: something is noticed, its hidden account is requested, and the people are brought to see the answer.
findings.containment: The ordinary meaning remains people issuing forth in separate groups to be shown their deeds. The finding adds the supplied question-to-report movement without turning the focus verb into an interrogative collocation or claiming a wider surah system.

epistemic.reason: The reviewed nomination and exact 99:3/99:4 context contacts support the movement, while its synthesis remains a bounded macro inference rather than a literal translation of the focus form.

findings.title: Showing receives an authorized message
findings.claim: The Lordship and divine-message expressions in 99:5 frame the focus showing as content imparted by an authoritative source before it becomes perceptible to the people.
findings.mechanism: The Lordship carrier supplies authority and the inspiration carrier supplies hidden transmission; together they meet the focus's caused-display verb and change showing from bare visibility into received disclosure.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see why the people are placed on the receiving side of the showing: the scene has first established who authorizes and transmits what will be seen.
findings.containment: The ordinary showing of deeds remains fully recoverable. The packet supports divine communication and authority here; it does not establish a dream scene or a surah-wide thesis.

epistemic.reason: Both context carriers are explicitly supplied at 99:5 and return through the focus display, while the authorized-message synthesis is a bounded contextual reading.

findings.title: Deeds enter opposed moral poles
findings.claim: The focus's accountable deeds are opened by 99:7-8 into the paired fields of beneficial good and harmful evil, so the showing carries moral direction as well as visibility.
findings.mechanism: The focus noun names intentional acts, while the two following parallel clauses attach good and evil to the same act-and-seeing frame; the context therefore supplies opposed consequences without replacing the ordinary object of showing.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees why the displayed works are not an undifferentiated record: the next two ayat keep both moral directions visible under the same act and seeing structure.
findings.containment: The focus still says that people are shown their deeds. The finding preserves both good and evil together and makes no additional judgment about a deed beyond the supplied paired terms.

epistemic.reason: The focus carrier and the exact positive and negative continuation are supplied, while the cross-ayah polarity is an interpretive contextual synthesis.

branch_activations.activation: Hesaba konu olan kasıtlı iş ile iki kutuplu devam cümleleri birleşince, odaktaki gösterim eylemlerin yalnızca kaydı değil, yönleriyle görünür edilmesi halini alır.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: İnsanlar, yaptıkları işlerin görünür kılınmasının yanında bu işlerin iyilik ve kötülük yönlerini taşıyan bir hesapla karşılaşır.
branch_activations.boundary: Bu, أَعْمَالَ kelimesini doğrudan خير veya شر diye çevirmeyi gerektirmez; iyi ve kötü kutupları sonraki bağlamın gerçek temaslarıdır.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: what all incline toward as good
branch_activations.facet_statement: what all incline toward as good
branch_activations.carrier: 99:7'deki خَيْرًا, ölçülen işin yarar ve iyilik yönünü taşıyan bağımsız bağlam taşıyıcısıdır.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Odak ayetindeki people ve their deeds relation, bu iyilik yönünün kime ait eylemde göründüğünü sağlar.
branch_activations.activation: İyilik taşıyıcısı, odaktaki accountable deeds and showing relation ile temas edince, displayed works become perceptible as actions with beneficial moral direction.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Gösterilen işler, yarar ve iyilik yönüyle de tanınan kasıtlı eylemler olarak görünür.
branch_activations.boundary: خيرًا burada odak kelimesine taşınan genel bir eş anlam değildir; 99:7'nin kendi moral pole contribution'dır.

branch_activations.facet_statement: evil and badness
branch_activations.carrier: 99:8'deki شَرًّا, ölçülen işin zarar ve kötülük yönünü taşıyan karşıt bağlam taşıyıcısıdır.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 99:7'de kurulmuş aynı ölçme ve görme çerçevesinin karşı kutba tekrar edilmesidir.
branch_activations.activation: Kötülük taşıyıcısı, focus deeds relation ile aynı ölçüm ve görünürlük yapısında buluşunca, hesap çerçevesi tek bir ahlaki yöne kapanmaz.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Gösterim, işlerin zarar ve kötülük yönünü de aynı açıklıkla görünür eden çift kutuplu bir hesap alanına açılır.
branch_activations.boundary: Şَرًّا, odak ayetindeki deeds anlamını silmez ve iyi-kötü ikiliğini bir tercih sırasına dönüştürmez.

findings.title: Separation becomes a visible form
findings.claim: The focus word for separated groups also opens a bounded image of well-spaced teeth; when it meets visible appearance and the following excellence term, separation becomes a form that can be seen and valued.
findings.mechanism: The spaced-teeth carrier in أَشْتَاتًا meets the appearance carrier in يُرَوْا and the chosen-excellence carrier in 99:7; their contact gives the focus separation a visible-form resonance while its group meaning remains present.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can feel how a word translated as 'separate groups' also gives separation a concrete visual pattern whose spacing is perceptible as a form of excellence.
findings.containment: People still emerge as separate groups in the ordinary reading. The packet supports a local visual analogy, not the claim that the people literally become teeth or that beauty governs the moral accounting.

epistemic.reason: All three carriers are supplied in the reviewed nomination and the relevant focus/context forms, while the visual-form synthesis remains a contained macro inference.

branch_activations.facet_statement: virtue and chosen excellence
branch_activations.carrier: 99:7'deki خَيْرًا, görünen biçime olumlu değer yükleyen seçilmiş iyilik ve excellence carrier'ıdır.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Odaktaki أَشْتَاتًا için supplied spaced-teeth image and the focus showing operation provide the form to which excellence can attach.
branch_activations.activation: Değer yargısı, görünür biçim ve ayrılmış düzen aynı local scene içinde buluşunca, separated state can be perceived as an ordered visible form.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Odaktaki ayrılık, yalnızca parçalanmış bir topluluk değil, görünür düzeni ve niteliği algılanan bir biçim olarak da duyulur.
branch_activations.boundary: خيرًا, people veya groups kelimesinin literal gloss'u değildir; visual excellence is a contextual resonance.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyin göze görünen dış yüzü, durumu veya belirtisi.
branch_activations.carrier: يُرَوْا, deeds'in people için visible appearance olarak ortaya çıkmasını sağlayan caused-display carrier'ıdır.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: أَشْتَاتًا için supplied spaced and separated form image, display'in neyi biçimlendirdiğini belirler.
branch_activations.activation: Görünür yüz ile aralıklı düzen birleşince, odaktaki separated groups image can be sensed as a readable surface rather than only a social arrangement.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Gösterilme eylemi, ayrılmışlığın dıştan seçilen biçimini de görünür kılar.
branch_activations.boundary: Appearance branch is used at its core visible-form facet; a literal mirror or a beauty judgment is not added here.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Dişler birbirinin üzerine binmez ve aralarında görünür aralıklar bulunur.
branch_activations.carrier: أَشْتَاتًا, ordinary dispersed-groups formunun yanında aralarında görünür aralık bulunan bir diziliş image'ını taşır.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: يُرَوْا ile 99:7'deki excellence, aralığın görünür ve olumlu biçim olarak okunmasını tetikler.
branch_activations.activation: Aynı surface word'deki ayrılmış düzen, seeing and excellence contacts ile buluşunca, dispersed state acquires a concrete spacing image.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: People's separate emergence remains visible, while its spacing can also be imagined as individually discernible intervals in a form.
branch_activations.boundary: The teeth collocation is a contained lexical image; it does not replace the focus's human groups or claim that their moral value is bodily beauty.

findings.title: Departure continues emergence
findings.claim: The earth's bringing-out in 99:2 gives the focus verb's issuing a prior station, so the people's departure can be felt as the outward continuation of what the earth has brought forth.
findings.mechanism: The context carrier أَخْرَجَتِ establishes emergence from within, and the focus carrier يَصْدُرُ carries departure from a previously reached or entered place; their contact turns the focus motion into a linked release.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees the issuing people as arriving after an earlier bringing-out, which gives the focus verb a direction and a point of origin that a flat translation leaves implicit.
findings.containment: The ordinary people and separate-groups reading remains intact. No worked road, water station, or traveler group is asserted after the route branch was excluded.

epistemic.reason: The two exact emergence/departure contacts are supplied, but the linked-release picture is a bounded contextual synthesis rather than a replacement gloss.

branch_activations.facet_statement: passing out from within
branch_activations.carrier: 99:2'deki أَخْرَجَتِ, earth'in içinde tutulan şeyi dışarı çıkarmasını ve emergence boundary'yi taşır.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Odaktaki يَصْدُرُ, daha önce bulunulan yerden outward departure relation'ını sağlar.
branch_activations.activation: Bringing-out carrier ile focus departure carrier birbirine bağlanınca, insanların çıkışı prior emergence'ın continuation'ı olarak yön kazanır.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: People's issuing is also the outward phase of a release begun when the earth brought out what it held.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus verb is not changed into a transitive extraction verb; 99:2 supplies the prior context action.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Daha önce varılan bir yerden veya girilen bir durumdan ayrılıp geri yönelmeyi belirtir.
branch_activations.carrier: يَصْدُرُ, ordinary issuing meaninginin yanında previously reached or entered place'ten ayrılma relation'ını taşır.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 99:2'de earth'in içeriden dışarı çıkardığı burdens, departure'ın prior station'ını kurar.
branch_activations.activation: Focus verb's departure relation, earth's prior bringing-out scene ile temas ederek people leaving as a return from an entered condition image'ını oluşturur.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The people's outward movement becomes a departure from the condition in which the earth had held and then released them.
branch_activations.boundary: No water-source, road, or general travel scene is added; the retained relation is only prior emergence to focus departure.

findings.title: The displayed deed acquires minute scale
findings.claim: The focus showing meets 99:7's weight and tiny-particle language, making each displayed deed perceptible as a minute, individually measured portion.
findings.mechanism: The weight carrier fixes quantity, the tiny-particle carrier fixes minimal scale, and the focus caused-display carrier returns both to the actor; the ordinary plural deeds therefore open into granular visibility.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees how the next ayah's tiny measure changes the scale of what is shown: even the smallest portion can arrive as a perceptible accountable unit.
findings.containment: People are still shown their deeds as the ordinary focus reading. The particle is a contextual scale image, not a claim that the focus noun literally means dust or that every moral polarity has been collapsed here.

epistemic.reason: The focus display and exact 99:7 measure/particle contacts are supplied; the minute-unit synthesis is a bounded macro inference.

branch_activations.facet_statement: standard weight and weighing
branch_activations.carrier: 99:7'deki مِثْقَالَ, displayed action'ın standard weight and weighing ile quantity kazanmasını taşır.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Focus'taki deeds are the object shown to their own agents, establishing what is being measured.
branch_activations.activation: Weighting context meets focus display, so showing includes a measure that fixes the amount of each visible deed.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The displayed deeds can be apprehended as measured portions rather than an unscaled mass.
branch_activations.boundary: The weight branch is contextually supplied by 99:7; it does not replace the focus noun's ordinary deeds meaning.

branch_activations.facet_statement: tiny scattered motes or ants
branch_activations.carrier: 99:7'deki ذَرَّةٍ, ölçümün ulaşabildiği en küçük scattered unit image'ını taşır.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Focus passive showing gives that tiny unit a recipient and makes it perceptually consequential.
branch_activations.activation: Tiny-unit carrier ile caused display buluşunca, what is shown can be imagined at a scale where no portion disappears from perception.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Even minute portions of action enter the visible account as individually present units.
branch_activations.boundary: This is a scale correspondence from 99:7, not a literal dust gloss for أَعْمَالَهُمْ.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyi başkasına gösterip onun görmesini sağlama.
branch_activations.carrier: يُرَوْا, bir şeyi people'e gösterip onların görmesini sağlayan focus operation'ını taşır.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 99:7'deki standard weight and tiny particle supply the minute content that the showing makes visible.
branch_activations.activation: Display carrier, weight, and tiny unit contact each other; the focus showing becomes the operation that exposes minute measured portions.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The people are shown not only their deeds as a whole but the small measured units into which the following context resolves them.
branch_activations.boundary: The display remains caused perception; no additional signification or source-of-expression branch is carried.

findings.title: Concealed content crosses into sight
findings.claim: The focus showing completes a local movement from hidden imparting and earth-report to bringing-out and visible display, so the deeds appear as concealed content made manifest.
findings.mechanism: The hidden-message carrier in 99:5, report carrier in 99:4, and bringing-out carrier in 99:2 each move content toward openness; the focus caused-display carrier gives the movement its perceptual endpoint.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees a staged change in status: what was hidden, reported, and brought out becomes something the people are made to see.
findings.containment: The ordinary focus says that people are shown their deeds. This finding describes the supplied context's concealment-to-display operation without claiming that every hidden thing in the surah belongs to one system or adding witness authority from another finding.

epistemic.reason: The four exact branch carriers and their focus return are supplied by the reviewed channel packet; the sequential manifest image is a contained macro synthesis.

branch_activations.facet_statement: disclosure or bringing out
branch_activations.carrier: 99:4'teki earth report, concealed information'ın disclosure and bringing-out direction'ını taşır.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 99:5'teki hidden imparting establishes that the report has content previously conveyed out of sight.
branch_activations.activation: Report and hidden message meet before the focus showing, so the focus receives the next stage of an already unfolding disclosure.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: People's being shown their deeds becomes the perceptual completion of content that has already entered the scene as report.
branch_activations.boundary: The report branch is contextual; the focus passive verb is not translated as 'to report'.

branch_activations.facet_statement: causing something to come out
branch_activations.carrier: 99:2'deki أَخْرَجَتِ, earth'in içeride tutulan şeyi outwardly present hale getirmesini taşır.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus's caused display supplies the later operation by which what has come out is made perceptible to people.
branch_activations.activation: Extraction and showing meet as consecutive exposure operations, giving the focus a prehistory of content crossing a boundary.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The deeds shown at the focus are also the content of a release from concealment into public perception.
branch_activations.boundary: The context branch does not make the focus verb transitive and does not claim that the earth literally contains every deed in the lexical gloss.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyi başkasına gösterip onun görmesini sağlama.
branch_activations.carrier: يُرَوْا, concealed content'i people için visible hale getiren caused-display operation'ını taşır.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 99:2, 99:4, and 99:5 supply the prior extraction, report, and hidden transmission sequence.
branch_activations.activation: Focus display gathers the preceding operations into a single recipient-facing endpoint and the following 99:7 seeing continuation confirms the visibility effect.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: People are made to see deeds that have moved from hidden status into manifest account.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not add a second ordinary object to the focus; the manifest content remains their deeds.

branch_activations.facet_statement: hidden imparting of knowledge
branch_activations.carrier: 99:5'teki أَوْحَىٰ, bilgiyi orada bulunan gözlerden gizli bir iletimle aktarma carrier'ıdır.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The report and bringing-out contexts show the imparted content moving toward disclosure.
branch_activations.activation: Hidden transmission supplies the concealed starting point, and focus display supplies the visible endpoint through which the people receive it.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The showing can be perceived as the moment an unseen imparting becomes available to human sight.
branch_activations.boundary: The hidden-message image is contextual and does not by itself establish dream, writing, or an independent witness claim.

findings.title: Separation opens into distribution
findings.claim: The focus state of separated groups receives a particle-scale distribution echo from the following tiny-unit clauses, making separation newly perceptible as many individually present points.
findings.mechanism: The focus dispersion carrier meets the 99:7-8 tiny-unit and repeated-seeing context; the people remain separated groups, while the scale of their visibility echoes a field made of distinct units.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can sense both the collective separation and the fine distribution within it, so 'separate groups' carries spatial texture rather than only social division.
findings.containment: The ordinary group separation remains primary. The narrowed finding retains only the focus dispersion branch; it does not claim the omitted grain-scattering, sunrise, or drying branches, nor a literal open field.

epistemic.reason: The focus dispersion form and exact following tiny-unit/seeing references are supplied; the spatial scale correspondence is an inference bounded away from the omitted branch images.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir arada bulunan kişilerin veya parçaların birlik düzenini yitirip birbirinden ayrılmasıdır.
branch_activations.carrier: أَشْتَاتًا, bir arada bulunan people or parts'ın birlik düzenini kaybedip ayrılması carrier'ını taşır.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 99:7-8'deki ذَرَّةٍ and repeated seeing supply the separate-unit scale that returns to this focus separation.
branch_activations.activation: Group dispersion meets tiny visible units, so the focus state gains a distribution texture without losing its ordinary social grouping.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: People issue forth as separated groups, and that separation can also be felt as a field of individually perceptible units.
branch_activations.boundary: Only the focus dispersion branch is retained; no grain-scattering, sunrise, drying-surface, or literal field image is asserted.

findings.title: Attributed earth-discharge sorting
findings.claim: The attributed HFT trace reads the focus departure as the sorted outward discharge of contents shaken loose from the earth and brought out from concealment.
findings.mechanism: The trace links 99:1 shaking, 99:2 earth, extraction, and retained weight to the focus's departure, dispersion, and caused showing; the preceding pressure changes the focus movement into release from a destabilized container.
findings.reader_payoff: The focus people become perceptible as what the earth has released and sorted, while their ordinary departure and separate grouping remain visible.
findings.containment: This is an attributed contextual HFT reading. The unresolved branch records carry no invented gloss or facet, and the finding does not claim that the ordinary translation is false or that the earth-discharge image is independently lexicalized in every focus word.

epistemic.reason: The HFT record has complete exact anchor coverage and returns through supplied focus coordinates, but its reader identity is legacy-unbound and its unresolved branch descriptors remain attributed.

branch_activations.carrier: The exact HFT trace attributes disturbance and shaking at 99:1 to this unresolved branch record.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied 99:1 shaking sequence is connected by the HFT trace to the later earth release and focus departure.
branch_activations.activation: The attributed disturbance supplies the destabilizing pressure before the earth's contents emerge.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus departure can be read as following a prior destabilization that breaks stable containment.
branch_activations.boundary: No independent gloss or facet is supplied for this unresolved branch; only the exact attributed role is retained.

branch_activations.carrier: The exact HFT trace attributes the 99:2 earth carrier to this unresolved branch record as the lower boundary from which contents rise.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 99:2 explicitly makes the earth bring out its burdens after the preceding shaking.
branch_activations.activation: The attributed earth-boundary role joins the shaking to the focus outflow and gives the release a container relation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: People's emergence is pictured as contents rising from a lower boundary that has opened.
branch_activations.boundary: The packet supplies no independent gloss or facet for this branch; the container reading remains attributed to the HFT role.

branch_activations.facet_statement: causing something to come out
branch_activations.carrier: 99:2'deki أَخْرَجَتِ, earth'in retained burdens'ı causing to come out operation'ını taşır.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The HFT trace links this extraction to the focus issuing and showing sequence.
branch_activations.activation: Extraction supplies the material release that the focus departure continues and the focus showing exposes.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The people who issue forth can be seen as the released contents of the earth's prior bringing-out.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch is retained in the HFT-attributed context role; it does not turn the focus verb into a second transitive extraction.

branch_activations.carrier: The exact HFT trace attributes retained weight at 99:2 to this unresolved branch record.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Earth's burdens are explicitly brought out before the focus names people's departure.
branch_activations.activation: The attributed weight role makes the released contents materially resistant and connects the earth's burden to the later outflow.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus departure carries the pressure of contents that had been retained as weight.
branch_activations.boundary: No independent branch gloss or facet is supplied; the weight role remains an attributed HFT contribution.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Daha önce varılan bir yerden veya girilen bir durumdan ayrılıp geri yönelmeyi belirtir.
branch_activations.carrier: يَصْدُرُ, daha önce varılan veya girilen yerden ayrılıp yönelme facet'ını taşıyan focus carrier'ıdır.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The attributed 99:1-2 shaking, earth, extraction, and weight chain supplies the prior station from which departure occurs.
branch_activations.activation: Focus departure meets the earth-discharge chain and becomes the outward flow after retained contents are released.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The people depart from the earth-bound condition into the separated showing scene.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch is presented with its supplied core facet and attributed context contact; no road or water-source specialization is added.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir topluluğu, işi veya bütünü birbirinden ayrı unsurlara dağıtma eylemini de kapsar.
branch_activations.carrier: أَشْتَاتًا, a gathered body resolving into separate elements through dispersion carrier'ını taşır.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The HFT trace supplies shaking, extraction, and departure as the pressure-driven sequence before this dispersion.
branch_activations.activation: Release from the earth meets the focus dispersion state, so scattering functions as the sorting phase of the discharge.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The released people emerge in separated formations, with dispersion describing how the discharge resolves their gathered body.
branch_activations.boundary: The ordinary separate-groups reading remains; this is an attributed sorting relation and not a claim of independent physical scattering agency in the focus grammar.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyi başkasına gösterip onun görmesini sağlama.
branch_activations.carrier: يُرَوْا, released and sorted contents'ı people için visible hale getiren caused-display operation'ını taşır.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The HFT trace connects physical emergence and sorting to the following exposure of deeds.
branch_activations.activation: Showing is the endpoint where the discharge's contents become evidentiary and perceptible.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus showing exposes both the released people and what their release carries into view: their deeds.
branch_activations.boundary: The physical-discharge picture is attributed HFT context; the ordinary object of showing remains their works.

findings.title: The recipient becomes the knower
findings.claim: The attributed HFT trace reverses the scene's epistemic direction: a human first voices bewilderment, the earth becomes an informed reporting subject under authorization, and people then receive their deeds as shown testimony.
findings.mechanism: The exact sequence moves speech from the questioning human to earth's report, grounds that report in Lordship and hidden imparting, and uses the focus's passive causative purpose to place humanity on the receiving side of knowledge.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the people do not generate the evidence they are shown; they arrive as recipients of a report whose source and authorization were established before the showing.
findings.containment: The ordinary purpose remains that people are shown their deeds. This attributed reading adds a source-and-recipient relation without denying a simple sequential reading or inventing independent glosses for unresolved HFT branches.

epistemic.reason: The HFT trace names exact context coordinates, roots, roles, and focus returns across 99:3-6; its unresolved reader identity requires qualification, not exclusion.

branch_activations.carrier: The exact HFT trace attributes the uttered human question at 99:3 to this unresolved saying record.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The question is the first explicit sign that the human lacks the event's explanation.
branch_activations.activation: Attributed speech without an answer creates the epistemic starting point that the focus showing later reverses.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus people arrive after a prior human statement of not knowing what is happening.
branch_activations.boundary: No independent gloss or facet is supplied for this unresolved branch; only the exact HFT role is carried.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: görerek fark etme; bağlama göre işitme, sezme ve bakıp araştırma
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyi gözle görerek fark etmeyi veya seçmeyi anlatır.
branch_activations.carrier: The exact trace attributes perception into awareness first to the human context carrier in 99:3 and then returns the human collective to the focus.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The human question and later passive showing place perception first as a lack and then as something received.
branch_activations.activation: The same attributed perception role crosses from the questioning human to the focus collective, making the focus a transfer point from sensing uncertainty to receiving disclosure.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: People who first confront an unexplained event are later positioned to have its meaning made perceptible to them.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not replace the ordinary human-collective sense of الناس or add a claim that every human perception is hidden knowledge.

branch_activations.carrier: The exact HFT trace attributes the earth's renewed speech/report at 99:4 to this unresolved branch record.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The preceding human question creates the transfer point at which informative speech changes speaker.
branch_activations.activation: Speech moves from a bewildered human to earth's report, preparing the focus showing as receipt of knowledge from another subject.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The people are shown deeds after the scene has transferred articulate disclosure to the earth.
branch_activations.boundary: No independent gloss or facet is supplied for this unresolved branch; the speaker-transfer role remains attributed.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: knowledge by report and tested inner knowledge
branch_activations.facet_statement: knowledge by report and tested inner knowledge
branch_activations.carrier: 99:4'teki أَخْبَارَهَا, earth'in report and inward knowledge carrier'ıdır.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The human question supplies an information need that makes this report more than an unconnected utterance.
branch_activations.activation: Report-based knowledge meets the focus's receiving people, so the focus purpose clause can be read as the arrival of testimony to its subjects.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The deeds appear to the people through an informed report that the earth has already articulated.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch is retained as an attributed context role; the focus does not become the word for report.

branch_activations.facet_statement: lordship, ownership, and authority
branch_activations.carrier: 99:5'teki ربَّكَ, earth'in report'unu yetkilendiren Lordship and authority carrier'ıdır.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The following أَوْحَىٰ supplies the hidden command or transmission that authorizes the report.
branch_activations.activation: Authority and hidden imparting meet earth's report before the focus showing, moving the people from questioners to recipients of authorized disclosure.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: What people are shown arrives as testimony whose authority was established before they receive it.
branch_activations.boundary: This is the exact attributed HFT relation, not an independent claim that the focus form itself names Lordship.

branch_activations.facet_statement: hidden imparting of knowledge
branch_activations.carrier: 99:5'teki أَوْحَىٰ, earth'e report its information through hidden imparting carrier'ıdır.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The report in 99:4 is the content that this hidden imparting makes available to the earth.
branch_activations.activation: Hidden transmission gives the earth's speech an authorized informational source, and the focus passive purpose makes people its receiving endpoint.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The showing is a transfer of knowledge from concealed authorization through earth's report to human perception.
branch_activations.boundary: Only the attributed hidden-imparting role is retained; no unlisted dream, writing, or fire facet is imported.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyi başkasına gösterip onun görmesini sağlama.
branch_activations.carrier: يُرَوْا, people who do not generate the evidence being made to see it operation'ını taşır.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The prior question, report, and authorization sequence supplies the transferred knowledge that the showing delivers.
